subject: Subprocessor attestation matrix + temporary escrow access for EdgeSight (Fintera)
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@fintera.com>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Cc: Derek Patel <dpatel@fintera.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Request: full subprocessor attestation matrix and temporary escrow access for new analytics partner

Hi Naomi —

We just received onboarding paperwork from a vendor (EdgeSight Analytics) who's going to ingest a limited subset of logs for transaction analytics. Compliance has asked us to get Redwood's full subprocessor attestation matrix (SOC2 scope, encryption, KMS use, personnel access list) and confirmation of whether EdgeSight can be granted temporary escrow access to logs for the migration window.

Specific asks:
- Full attestation matrix for all subprocessors touching logs (encryption in transit/at rest, KMS provider, key management boundaries)
- SOC 2 scope confirmation for the pipeline that touches EU tenant data
- Maximum temporary access window Redwood will permit and process for granting temporary log access to a third party (what auditing/evidence will Redwood produce)
- Any standard contract addendum or DPA wording we should expect (Fintera legal will likely request limited redlines)

We're on a tight timetable — can you confirm what you can provide and by when? Ideally by EOD Monday (2026-10-11) so our legal can review before the integration kickoff.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Head of Compliance
Fintera Payments

Attachments: EdgeSight_onboarding_summary.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@fintera.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 11:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: full subprocessor attestation matrix and temporary escrow access for new analytics partner

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the detail and the deadline. We're on it. Quick summary of next steps from our side:
- I'll own delivering the attestation matrix and a short summary of SOC2 scoping for the EU pipeline.
- Kimberly will gather the KMS/encryption details and export controls.
- Rishi (security) will prepare an evidence package that describes the temporary access process (audit logs, time-limited creds, and approval flow).

We have a standard temporary-access policy we can share; it includes a maximum 14-day window and full audit export. If Fintera needs shorter windows or more restrictive controls that's fine — we can call that out in the DPA addendum.

I expect to provide the attestation matrix (spreadsheet) and the temp-access policy draft by Friday EOB (2026-10-09). If legal needs to propose DPA redlines sooner, please send the redline to legal@redwood.com and loop me in.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Trust & Security (Contracts lead for this request)
Redwood Inference

--

Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 08:22:00 +0000
Subject: Internal: Evidence items for EdgeSight request

Naomi —

I've pulled the following items for the attestation matrix and evidence package:
- KMS provider: AWS KMS (multi-tenant CMKs for hosted API; customer CMKs available for Dedicated/Private)
- Transit encryption: TLS 1.3; mTLS for internal services touching logs
- Rest encryption: AES-256-GCM at storage layer; per-tenant encryption for Dedicated
- Personnel access: role-based access lists exported monthly (we'll include the last 90-day access audit)
- SOC2 scope: logging pipeline and ingestion layer are in-scope; model serving layer is separate — we'll clarify boundaries in the matrix.

Jordan: can you pull the last export of the monthly access audit and confirm the log retention snapshot we can provide? Rishi: can you draft the temp-access approval template and the list of audit exports we'll hand over post-window (CSV of access events + signed attestation)?

I'll assemble the matrix workbook and attach attestation lines for each subprocessor. Planning to send to Samantha Friday morning.

-Kim

Attachments referenced: attestation_matrix_20261007.xlsx (draft)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@fintera.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 14:10:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Subprocessor attestation matrix + temporary escrow access for EdgeSight (Fintera)

Samantha —

Please find attached the requested materials:
- attestation_matrix_20261007.xlsx (tabbed workbook listing every subprocessor, scope, encryption controls, SOC2 in-scope boolean, and point-of-contact)
- edgesight_temp_access_policy.pdf (temporary access process: approval flow, time-limited credentials, audit exports)

Key clarifications:
- SOC2 scope: the ingestion/logging pipeline that will feed EdgeSight is included in our SOC2 scope (controls mapped to CC6/CC7 relevant to access and logging).
- KMS & keys: hosted API uses AWS KMS; if Fintera requires customer-managed keys we can enable that under Dedicated/Private contracts — note that enabling CMKs will affect throughput/latency SLAs and is a separate procurement item.
- Temporary access window: standard maximum of 14 days; we can do a shorter window on request. All temporary sessions are fully audited and we will produce a signed access event export at the end of the window.

For DPA language: we've attached a suggested DPA addendum that documents the escrow access and audit deliverables. We saw a brief redline from your legal team (dpa_redline_v1.docx) and will have our legal review that next week.

Links: HubSpot ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/ticket/FP-239
DocuSign (temporary-access agreement): https://www.docusign.com/sign/EDGE-SIGHT-ACCESS-20261007

If you'd like, we can do a 30-minute sync with Rishi + our legal to walk through the attestation items and the access process.

Regards,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Trust & Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: attestation_matrix_20261007.xlsx; edgesight_temp_access_policy.pdf; dpa_addendum_template.docx

From: Derek Patel <dpatel@fintera.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@fintera.com>, Fintera Legal <legal@fintera.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 16:45:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Subprocessor attestation matrix + temporary escrow access for EdgeSight (Fintera)

Naomi / team —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the materials. We've reviewed the attestation matrix and the temp-access policy; everything looks in scope. A couple of small asks from legal:
1) We proposed one limited redline to the DPA addendum around the export format for audit logs (they want a JSON schema instead of CSV).
2) Can you confirm whether the signed access-event attestation will include a hash of the exported logs for tamper evidence?

If those two items are feasible, we can sign the temporary-access DocuSign and move to onboarding next week. We can join the sync you've offered if helpful.

Short answer: we accept the approach pending the two clarifications above.

Thanks,
Derek Patel
VP, Integrations
Fintera Payments
